J-33.name: Import real data from a selectable, key-aware provider source
J-33.last_evidence_path: BUILT THIS ITER but PARTIAL — blocked by a verified PRINCIPAL-anti-goal breach. PASSING machinery (browser QA 12/13, evaluator-source-verified): config-driven 5-source catalog [yahoo(default,no-key)/tiingo/finnhub/alpha_vantage/stooq] in config.yaml (no hardcoded list); boot validation -> ConfigError (dup id / missing env_var-when-needs_key / default∉catalog); compute_provider_availability env-detected, env-var NAME only (no key value); make_provider resolves every id, each client raises ProviderUnavailableError on non-OK/unparseable (mocked HTTP, ZERO fabricated bars); source threading (omitted->default_source; unknown->400; needs-key-no-key->explicit 400 w/ env-var name); UI Import-source <select> from data.sources + session-only type=password key field (useState only, cleared on completion/unmount, never localStorage/URL/cookie); J-17 backfill preserved (UT-10); J-18 one-date-select preserved (UT-13). FAILING clause (THE blocker): the pasted session key is ECHOED BACK in GET /api/data/jobs/{id} errors[] and rendered in the /data job card. Root cause: data_providers/_http.py:42 raises ProviderUnavailableError(f'...: {exc}') where str(httpx.HTTPStatusError) embeds the full request URL incl. ?token=<key> (tiingo:46 / finnhub:53 / alpha_vantage:51 put the key in URL query params) -> _do_fetch:298 _record_error -> JobProgress.errors -> to_dict() -> response + UI (page.tsx job card). CONTAINED/NON-DURABLE (evaluator-confirmed + QA + browser-QA leak-map): NOT persisted — _persist_run writes only structured counts + _final_summary (no errors[]); DB data_provider_runs clean, run-history clean, GET /api/data clean, backend log clean, committed files clean; frontend storage clean. Violates the iteration's PRINCIPAL anti-goal 'Import keys are env-or-session... never echoed back in any response' + DoD 'absent from GET /api/data/jobs/{id}'. Evidence: reports/qa/...-iter-21-evidence/UT-08-FAIL-key-leak-in-job-card-errors.png; QA FAIL (TC-05/07/11); browser-QA FAIL (UT-08 P1); status.json status=blocked. FIX (iter-22, gates J-33->passing): redact key/URL-query from provider error strings before raising (e.g. exc.request.url.copy_with(query=None)+status_code, and/or header auth) + a REAL-httpx-error regression test (the mocked key-never-persisted test missed this path). The 502-green suite does NOT cover the leak.

anti_goal_violations.anti_goal: Import keys are env-or-session, never persisted. ... a provider key MUST be read from the environment, or — if the user pastes one into the import UI — held in memory for that run only, never written to disk, the run log, the DB, or any committed file, and never echoed back in any response. (the iteration's PRINCIPAL anti-goal)
anti_goal_violations.evidence: VERIFIED BREACH of the 'never echoed back in any response' clause (and DoD 'absent from GET /api/data/jobs/{id}'). A pasted SESSION-ONLY API key is echoed verbatim in GET /api/data/jobs/{id} errors[] and rendered in the /data job card. Root cause (evaluator-confirmed in source): apps/backend/app/data_providers/_http.py:42 raises ProviderUnavailableError(f'{label} request failed for {symbol!r}: {exc}') where str(httpx.HTTPStatusError) embeds the full request URL including ?token=<key> / ?apikey=<key> (key-in-URL-query providers: tiingo_provider.py:46, finnhub_provider.py:53, alpha_vantage_provider.py:51); the message flows _do_fetch:298 _record_error -> JobProgress.errors -> to_dict() -> GET /api/data/jobs/{id} -> page.tsx job card. Evidence: reports/qa/...-iter-21-evidence/UT-08-FAIL-key-leak-in-job-card-errors.png; QA report FAIL (TC-05/TC-07/TC-11); browser-QA FAIL (UT-08, P1); status.json status=blocked. SEVERITY = minor/NON-HALTING (not a REGRESSION-class critical): the leak is CONTAINED and NON-DURABLE — the key is reflected only to the same user's own transient in-memory job-status within the session they pasted it; it is NOT persisted (DB data_provider_runs / run-history / backend log / committed files / GET /api/data / frontend storage all evaluator+QA-confirmed CLEAN — _persist_run writes only structured counts + _final_summary, never errors[]). It is NOT a committed-secret / external-exposure / backdoor. BUT it is a HARD BLOCKER: J-33 stays partial (not passing) until fixed, and this unresolved violation VETOES any future GOAL_ACHIEVED. FIX (iter-22): redact the key/URL-query from provider error strings before they enter ProviderUnavailableError (e.g. derive the message from exc.request.url.copy_with(query=None)+response.status_code, and/or send the key via an Authorization header, and/or scrub the resolved key value), and treat job error strings as untrusted-for-secrets before serving; ADD a real-httpx-HTTPStatusError (key-in-URL) regression test through get_daily -> JobProgress.errors -> GET /api/data/jobs/{id} asserting the sentinel is absent (closes the mocked-provider blind spot that let it pass the 502-green suite).
